title: Convert a book
blurb: Turn a PDF or ebook into a clean EPUB, PDF and more.
steps: Pick the book. It is copied into file_conversion/file_inbox.
Choose the formats you want. The finished files land in file_outbox.
If it is a scan, 'Let an AI settle doubtful OCR words' leaves fewer words for you to review.

sentence_check.label: Let an AI settle doubtful OCR words (scans)

mark.label: Stop to mark the layout first

title: Fix OCR words
blurb: Decide on the words the OCR was not sure about.
steps: Convert the book first. A book with words to review gets drafts and waits.
Pick the PDF in the book's folder in file_work (the one next to its .fixes.tsv).
Decide on each word in the browser, press 'Save decisions', then press Stop here.
Convert the book again: your decisions are applied.

title: Teach it the layout
blurb: Show it what headings, footnotes and running heads look like.
steps: Pick a text PDF in file_inbox. For a scan, convert it with 'Stop to mark the layout first': it stops after OCR and prints the PDF to mark, in file_work.
Mark examples on the page that opens. Every change is saved at once to <book>.marks.json next to the PDF.
Press v for the review view and d for the next doubtful page. Press Stop here when done: it lists what is still to check.
Convert the book again: it follows your marks.

title: Send to Kindle
blurb: One step from a PDF to a Kindle-ready EPUB.
steps: Pick the PDF. Scans are OCR'd when needed.
The EPUB is written next to the PDF.

title: Find a free book
blurb: Find a free copy online, download the best one and check its quality.
steps: Type the title and, if you know it, the author.
The best copy lands in file_conversion/file_inbox.
